name: coram
description: Search and inspect authorized Coram CCTV footage and physical-security activity.

interface.longDescription: Coram helps authorized security and operations teams search recorded CCTV footage, inspect stored camera snapshots, review physical door-access events and security alerts, and check camera health. View available evidence cards and open footage in Coram. Requires a Coram account with access to the relevant organization and data. This integration provides read-only security workflows; it does not unlock doors, change permissions, or delete records. Stored snapshots may lag real time, and media cards do not provide embedded live video.
defaultPrompt: Was there any package delivered yesterday?
What are names of users who badged in the last 24 hours, and were there any forced-entry or door-held-open alerts?
How many cameras are online right now and what has been their uptime in the past week?

positive.description: Search recorded footage for evidence of a package delivery.
positive.prompt: Was there any package delivered yesterday?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether recorded footage contains likely package deliveries yesterday, with camera, location, timestamp, and clickable timeline links for each match, or clearly states that no matching footage was found.

positive.description: Correlate successful physical-access activity with forced-entry and door-held-open alerts.
positive.prompt: What are the names of users who badged in during the last 24 hours, including entries using a PIN or the mobile app, and were there any forced-entry or door-held-open alerts?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the resolved user names associated with badge, PIN, or mobile-app access events in the last 24 hours and separately reports any forced-entry or door-held-open alerts, without treating device events and alert instances as the same source. For relevant available event evidence, display selected media cards with Open in Coram links; explicitly report unavailable previews.

positive.description: Combine current camera health with seven-day uptime history.
positive.prompt: How many cameras are online right now, and what has their uptime been during the past week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the current online-camera count and the seven-day uptime percentage for each currently online camera, including clear numerator and denominator context for fleet-level percentages.

positive.description: Display evidence for recent door activity in the dedicated demo tenant.
positive.prompt: Show me granted access events at the Front Door in the past 24 hours, with available image previews.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Front Door in the demo tenant, query granted events using the site timezone, select returned media item IDs and display cards with timestamps and source links. If no events or previews exist, say so. Do not infer entry direction from a door event or claim a nearby image is the exact event frame. Ask for clarification if the door or tenant is ambiguous.

positive.description: Display the latest stored snapshot from a door camera.
positive.prompt: Show me the latest image from the door camera.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the door camera and renders its latest stored snapshot inline, together with the camera and location names and the frame's capture time. It notes that the image is a stored snapshot rather than a live frame and calls out any material delay between capture time and the request.

negative.description: Do not use Coram to analyze a video file stored on the user's computer.
negative.prompt: What is happening in the video file I downloaded to my computer?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because the request concerns a local video file rather than CCTV footage captured and stored by Coram.

negative.description: Do not claim unsupported physical access mutations.
negative.prompt: Unlock the Front Door and delete its access history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot unlock doors or delete history; perform no mutation and do not claim success.

negative.description: Do not access an unauthorized tenant.
negative.prompt: Show camera footage from a Coram organization that my account cannot access.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guess tenant identifiers or bypass authorization. Explain that only organizations available to the connected account can be accessed; do not return unauthorized footage.

publication.release_notes: This submission replaces the Coram plugin published under our private account: https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a91d14f39808191955f96467c97438d. We are resubmitting under the Coram AI corporate account because we have no available way to migrate the existing plugin from the private account to the corporate account. Once this replacement is approved, we will unpublish the previous plugin. Version 1.0.1 retains Coram workflows for CCTV search, camera status, security alerts and physical access activity, together with the Coram guide.
